note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation in this book was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS New Testament wording and the self-rendered Old Testament wording of the first edition; the UBS credit line is no longer owed for this work.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, verses joined, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'; a verbatim recitation without quote marks counts (founder rule, 2026-11-19). `self_rendered` rows each carry a `why`: allusions and the author's own paraphrases left as prose, the father's hymn, word studies of the English Bible's renderings, and verses recast to another person.

Judgement calls: the book's title «ከእሳት የተነጠቀ ትንታግ» stays the book's title, but where the body quotes 'a brand plucked from the burning' it gives OWB's Zechariah 3:2 «ከእሳት የተነጠቀ የሚነድ ጉማጅ», bridged once with «(ትንታግ)» at its first occurrence (chapter 1). Micah 4:13 is OWB's «ተነሺና አሂጂ», glossed once «(ውቂ)» because the sermon argues from 'thresh'. Romans 12:2 is OWB's 'mind' (አእምሮ), so the next paragraph's 'the mind, not the clothing' follows it. 1 John 3:8 'He that committeth sin is of the devil' is OWB's «ኃጢአት ማድረግን የሚቀጥል የዲያብሎስ ነው»: the author's sentence stays true under it (decision doth-not-commit-sin). Leviticus 22:2's 'that they separate themselves' is OWB's 'be careful with the holy gifts', quoted as OWB pieces. Proverbs 8:17's 'seek me early' is OWB's 'diligently' (ተግተው). 'I am crucified with Christ' is OWB's Galatians 2:19 (the rest 2:20), so that row is recorded as 2:19-20; 'times of refreshing' is OWB's Acts 3:20. Psalm 22:1 (not Matthew 27:46) serves 'My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?'.
